LESSON: AFRICAN DIASPORAS

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Political Development and Governance
Topic 5.4: African Diasporas
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers African Diasporas, part of Political Development and Governance in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade seven SOCIAL STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: How can we promote African Unity in society today?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on African Diasporas together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Learning to Learn: Learners are motivated to learn continuously as they use library resources to research on the factors that

contributed to the movement of African diasporas to various parts of the world.

● Digital literacy: Learners use digital technology to accomplish their own task as they watch a video or You- Tube on the role

of the diasporas in the political development in Africa.

Values:
● Social Justice: Learners demonstrate cooperation as they watch a video or You- Tube on the role of diasporas in the political

development in Africa.

● Patriotism: Learners apply democracy and rule of law as they debate on the role of diasporas in the political development in

Africa.

● Creative Thinking: Learners use print or digital resources to indicate on the world map countries inhabited by African

● Social Cohesion: Learners debate on the role of diasporas in the political development in Africa.

Link to other learning areas:

Learners use computer skills to watch a video or You- Tube on the role of diasporas in the political development in Africa.
